name: DCA-SYS-00 · Central Error Hub (every failure, one place, in plain language)

parameters.content:
## 🧭 Central Error Hub — the spine of the system
**Every failure, from every template, in one place.**

### Setup (about 8 minutes, do this ONCE)
1. Import and **Activate** this workflow.
2. Open **every other template** → `Settings` → **Error Workflow** →
   choose **DCA-SYS-00 · Central Error Hub**.
3. **⚙️ Config** → set `alertEmail`.
4. Attach SMTP to **📨 Send alert**.

That is it. From now on, if anything anywhere breaks, you hear about it
**once**, in language you can act on.

### Why this is worth more than any single template
A template that fails silently costs you money for weeks. This is the
difference between owning a system and owning a pile of files.

### 🎚️ Severity is business impact, not stack trace
| Level | Means | You get |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 🔴 **critical** | a customer paid and did not get it | immediate alert |
| 🟠 **high** | money at risk — fraud, dispute, dunning | immediate alert |
| 🟡 **medium** | marketing/support degraded | immediate alert |
| ⚪ **low** | logging, reporting | counted only |

A failed delivery and a failed analytics write are not the same
emergency, and treating them alike teaches you to ignore both.

### 🌊 Storm suppression
When an upstream API goes down the same error fires hundreds of times.

Forwarding every one buries all other signals and trains you to ignore
alerts — **worse than having none at all**.

So the first occurrence alerts. Repeats inside `stormWindowMinutes` are
counted silently, and you get one summary instead of two hundred pages.

### 🗣️ Written for a seller, not an engineer
`ECONNREFUSED` is not actionable.

*"Your email provider refused the connection — check the SMTP
credential in n8n"* is.

Every alert carries a likely cause and a concrete next step. Add your own
patterns in **🔎 Explain the failure** as you learn your own recurring
problems.

nodes.name: 🚨 Any workflow failed
nodes.notes: Fires when any workflow that names this one as its Error Workflow fails.

nodes.name: ⚙️ Config
nodes.notes: Set alertEmail and you are done. The template lists control severity ranking.

nodes.name: 🎚️ Rank by business impact
nodes.notes: Severity reflects what it costs, not what it looks like in a stack trace.

nodes.name: 🌊 Suppress repeat storms
nodes.notes: First occurrence alerts; repeats inside the window are counted silently.

nodes.name: 🔎 Explain the failure
nodes.notes: Plain-language cause and fix. Extend PATTERNS as you learn your own recurring errors.

nodes.name: 🔔 Alert or just record?
nodes.notes: Applies the alertOnLow preference on top of storm suppression.

nodes.name: 📨 Send alert
nodes.notes: Attach SMTP. Swap for Slack/Telegram if you prefer — the text is ready either way.

nodes.name: 📒 Failure log
nodes.notes: Append to Sheets/Airtable. Review monthly — the pattern tells you what to fix.
